data.encoding: one ciphertext per bit, least significant bit first; the bit is the constant coefficient of the plaintext

operations.programs: identified by the keccak256 hash of the canonical form of the program document

correctness.relation: the decryption of an output equals the program applied to the decryptions of the inputs
conditions: every input ciphertext encrypts a constant polynomial that is 0 or 1
the multiplicative depth of the program does not exceed the limit of this profile
inputs and evaluation key belong to the same key context and key epoch
correctness.failure: the probability of an incorrect decryption is not quantified by this profile; parameters are those the library generates for the stated depth
correctness.undetected: an executor that deviates from the program is not detected by the scheme; see evidence

security.decryptionRelease: partial decryptions carry flooding noise; results leave the key holders only through recorded disclosures of whole view outputs
security.inputProofs: none: a submitter is not proven to have encrypted a well-formed value
security.circuitPrivacy: none: an output may reveal how it was computed to whoever can decrypt it

compatibility.objectFormat: FHEIFOBJ1: count, then length-prefixed serialized ciphertexts
compatibility.combines: objects of one key context and one key epoch
compatibility.unknown: an object of another profile, key context or key epoch is refused, not converted

operationCorrect.equivalence: identical bytes under the same library version, context, evaluation key, inputs and program
